    def route_load(rt):
        s = 0

            s += demands[n]

    def route_cost(rt):
        if not rt:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][rt[0]]
        for i in range(len(rt) - 1):
            c += matrix[rt[i]][rt[i + 1]]
        c += matrix[rt[-1]][depot]

                # We'll compute directly:

                # old edges: (b->c) and (d->e)
                old = matrix[b][c] + matrix[d][e]
                new = matrix[b][d] + matrix[c][e]
                delta = new - old
